title: The Verdict of the Fens Anew
author: Mirabel Hartwell
blurb: Jude Halloran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
